caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a figure resembling a clown or jester, wearing a conical red hat with some visible paint wear, and a garment with alternating red and blue sleeves. The face is expressive, with wide eyes, an open mouth showing teeth, and detailed facial features that are largely colored in shades of gray, black, and white, with light blue accents in the eyes. The figure's collar has a jagged, zigzag pattern in pale blue and white with red edges. The left arm (on the viewer's right) extends forward, with an open palm and fingers visible, colored in shades of pink and brown with black outlining. On the right side of the chest (the figure's left), there is a star-like shape with a red circle in the center on the blue background. The figure's garment is decorated with black round buttons down the center, and the colors appear somewhat worn or chipped, giving a distressed look. The background is plain and off-white, and the composition centers the figure in the frame.
title: Humpty Dumpty Mechanical Bank
